about.title:
We Are Your Bridge
to Korean Healthcare
about.subtitle: Gyeongcheong was founded to make Korean medical care accessible to every Mongolian patient — with trusted coordinators, world-class hospitals, and full support from start to finish.
about.storyP1: Gyeongcheong was established to solve a real problem: Mongolian patients wanting world-class medical treatment in Korea had no trusted guide to help them navigate the system.
about.storyP2: We built a team of Mongolian-speaking coordinators based in Seoul who know both cultures — people who make you feel at home even when you're far from it.
about.storyP3: Today we work with 50+ certified Korean hospitals across oncology, cardiology, orthopedics, plastic surgery, dental care, and more.
about.cardDesc: From Ulaanbaatar to Seoul — we handle everything so you can focus on your health.
about.servicesSubtitle: Everything you need for a successful medical journey to Korea.
about.svc1Desc: We match you with the right hospital based on your diagnosis, budget, and preferences.
about.svc2Desc: A dedicated Mongolian-speaking coordinator accompanies you through every step.
about.svc3Desc: Visa, accommodation, airport pickup, and all logistics handled for you.
about.ctaSubtitle: Contact us today for a free consultation with our team.
